about: Node.js versions at which bundle-lockfile's hooks behave differently (src/hooks.cjs, src/register.cjs, src/esm-wrap.cjs). The other jobs run the newest package of each Node.js line; .github/workflows/node-versions.yaml runs these: the pr ones on every pull request, all of them weekly and when the hooks change. Wolfi keeps old builds: 'nodejs-<major>~<version>' installs one, with Wolfi's current npm, or the one a version names (npm 12 does not run on every Node.js). The unit tests run on each; the fixtures (a regex, as gen.cjs and run.cjs take it) on each that names them, or those of 'fixtures' below.

versions.why: the oldest Node.js in Wolfi, the oldest supported: loader-thread hooks without isInternalThread. only bundlers that support it (Vite 7 and 8, Rolldown, rspack 2 and Rsbuild 2 need 20.19 or 22.12): webpack 5, Rollup's command line, Vite 5; npm 12 needs 22.22.2, 24.15 or 26
the last Node.js 22 without worker_threads.isInternalThread, so register.cjs cannot tell Node's own loader thread from a worker
isInternalThread: Node's loader thread runs --require preloads, and register.cjs does nothing there
the last 22 before nodejs/node#59929 (a null CommonJS source from loader-thread hooks reaches in-thread hooks)
#59929, and Yarn Plug'n'Play's loader provides the source of the CommonJS files in its zip cache (cjsSource)
the last 24 with loader-thread hooks: in-thread hooks are not safe next to another loader before 24.12 (syncHooksSafe)

the first version with in-thread hooks (module.registerHooks, nodejs/node#60380); nodejs/node#63060 (synthetic require of CommonJS modules an in-thread hook changed, with any --loader) from here to 24.17
in-thread hooks, Yarn Plug'n'Play not yet providing CommonJS source on 24
Yarn Plug'n'Play provides CommonJS source on 24 (cjsSource with in-thread hooks), inside the #63060 window
--experimental-package-map, which Yarn can add to NODE_OPTIONS
module.register is deprecated at runtime (DEP0205); #63060 still there
